direct_poll.mode: Phone: 64% live cellphone, 10% live landline; 26% text-invited to web survey. English. Random stratified draw from Aristotle registered voter file; LV status modeled from voter turnout validation. PDF says LV and RV n are equal.
direct_poll.moe_scope: Full VA-05 likely-voter sample; includes weighting/design effect 1.34. Not a subgroup MOE.
direct_poll.newer_poll_search: No first-party directly sourced VA-05 poll with later field dates found in the WaPo archive/source search; bounded search only.
direct_poll.prompt: Tom Perriello (D) vs John McGuire (R); for whom would you vote/lean; already-voted respondents reported their vote.
direct_poll.subsample_limits: 600 is districtwide LV n. PDF gives no unweighted subgroup bases or subgroup candidate MOEs. The captured official Google CSV export (gid=0) is VA-01 n=609 only; it supplies no VA-05 crosstabs.
